system.description:
A cunning, smart fighter who wins by outthinking rather than outmuscling.

  • Exploit Opening: Advantage vs a creature currently distracted, deceived, or at disadvantage due to something set up this combat.
  • Read the Room: Advantage on Insight when reading opponents. Advantage when casing a location or situation before acting.
